summary: READ-ONLY isolated diagnosis for BUG #3 and #6 completed with in-memory fakes only (no real DB writes, no production API actions). Reproduced transport/classification/gating/UI-state issues and approve-action race behavior.

critical.issue: scope_confirmation queue event is not forwarded by watchdog and done payload omits awaiting_scope_confirmation/scope_confirmation_proposal_id, so client relying on done frame loses scope-confirm state.

Exact phrase 'Confirm and proceed' classified as casual/new_request (heuristic tier=casual, pending_action classify_confirm_intent=new_request, is_confirmation_reply=false), allowing casual short-circuit with 0 tools.
_scope_confirmation_gate only validates scope_confirmed_proposal_id when mode_confidence.needs_confirm=true; confirm_proposal checks proposal_id+user_id+prompt but not session/project binding.
No atomic claim between read-check and approve/execute logging; two concurrent approve calls can both execute and log approved+executed twice.

minor.issue: create_backlog_item writes only ora_backlog_items; does not create cto_tasks/ora_self_bugs/cto_founder_suggestions and does not schedule any executor job for those surfaces.

ui_bugs.issue: Card sets resolved='confirmed' before callback outcome, so UI can show 'Confirmed — proceeding…' even if callback is stale/no-op/failure.
resolveAction uses r?.data?.ok !== false, so {ok:null} and {} are treated as success and rendered as 'Approved and executed.'

integration_issues.issue: api.streamChat supports onScopeConfirmation frames, but ChatPanel streamChat call does not provide onScopeConfirmation handler and relies on done payload fields that are absent.
Approved status shown even on malformed/missing ok response, and action result identifiers are not surfaced in recent action list.

issues: Result IDs/errors are not shown in list rows despite backend carrying proposal_id/result/error fields.
Recent actions fetch errors are swallowed silently (catch ignore), reducing operator observability.

action_items: Add explicit scope_confirmation event forwarding branch in watchdog consume loop and/or durable done-frame scope fields consumed by ChatPanel.

Harden confirmation phrase routing for 'Confirm and proceed' across intent_gateway/pending_action/response_confidence boundary so it does not fall into casual new-request path when confirming pending fix.
Scope confirmation gate should validate/consume confirm proposal ID independent of new needs_confirm recomputation and bind confirmation to expected session/project when required.
Make approve_action atomic (single claim transition) to prevent double-approve/double-execute races.
In OraChatDrawer resolveAction, treat missing/null ok as failure and surface result backlog_id/error details in resolved and audit UI.
critical_code_review_comments: watchdog.py lacks ev['type']=='scope_confirmation' branch while worker emits it.
stream.py done_payload omits awaiting_scope_confirmation/scope_confirmation_proposal_id though ChatPanel reads those from done frame.
ScopeConfirmCard optimistic resolved state is set before async result confirmation.
approve_action has TOCTOU race (read proposed -> separate writes/execute) with no transactional claim.
OraChatDrawer uses permissive success predicate (ok !== false), enabling false-positive execution UI.
seed_data_creation: None. In-memory fake DB objects only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: No production incident reconstruction was attempted (missing original prod IDs). All reproductions were isolated and MOCKED/in-memory only. ScopeConfirmCard dynamic React execution was not run via vitest due project include filter; structural/static proof plus source-order probe and existing OraChatDrawer tests were used.
rca of the issue: #3 transport/classifier gap is multi-point: worker emits scope_confirmation + result flags, watchdog drops scope_confirmation, stream done payload omits scope fields, ChatPanel does not subscribe to onScopeConfirmation callback and depends on done fields; additionally 'Confirm and proceed' phrase falls through casual/new_request classifiers causing tool-less short-circuit. #6 behavior split: create_backlog_item only creates ora_backlog_items (not tasks/self-repair/suggestions), while frontend resolveAction treats malformed responses as success; approve_action also has non-atomic approve race that can duplicate approved/executed events under concurrency.
